$comment: Reviewed narrative dependencies for the authored prologue, route chapters and short arrival episodes. Development pause scenes are explicitly marked. Extend this map when adding scenes.

introduces.early_ship: a ship has docked a day early

introduces.fold: a thin fold in the air

introduces.supper_gift: a bundle wrapped in a cloth

introduces.hall_entrance: a low opening in the ice

introduces.nibbled_cuff: The kid gives it an interested nibble

introduces.blankets: Damp blankets hang over a rail

introduces.grazing_route: It led to the herd's sheltered grazing ledge

introduces.drift_markers: small stones marking the safe way

introduces.hollow_found: Now you can see the hollow

introduces.chime_rules: An echo means it will stay open and let you come back

introduces.supper_gift: a supper bundle from her pack
a supper bundle for the herder

introduces.gap: part of the shelf has fallen away

introduces.crack: A stream of meltwater cuts across the shelf

introduces.slope: a sheet of ice pours down

introduces.wind_hole: A dark hole the size of a bucket

introduces.moved_stone: big stone at the counting circle moved

introduces.footprint: Pip lays his measuring cord beside the empty hollow.

introduces.witness: A keeper brings two counting slates from a cloth bag.

introduces.count: The two views can both be true.

introduces.road_load: A small handcart waits on the road above the stone.

introduces.warning: The water reaches the counting circle.

introduces.runoff: A trickle from the ridge begins filling the low side of the hollow.

introduces.visit: Two more dragonling neighbors arrive and stop at your warning.

introduces.supply: A gust lifts the corner of Pip's loose drawing.

introduces.agreement: The keepers have enough observations to plan another count.

introduces.motion_test: Beside the stone, a narrow fold bends the air.

introduces.departure_plan: The neighboring stone keepers ask what visitors should carry away from this place.

introduces.handover: Before you leave, the keepers ask you to walk through the plan once without help.

introduces.stone_priority: Pip has room for one large drawing on the page he will show the next Riftseekers he meets.

introduces.sky_map: The keeper spreads a cloth map between two flat stones.

introduces.whale_listen: The nearest whale gives a long low note, then falls quiet as the folds pulse.

introduces.keeper_lesson: The keeper brings a small reed whistle from her pouch and blows one gentle note toward an empty patch of sky.

introduces.olivia_question: Olivia asks to compare your map with her notebook.

introduces.wind_flags: A change in wind presses the grass flat along one edge of the working area.

introduces.signal_pair: From behind the waiting rope, the folds narrow and widen together.

introduces.loose_kit: A rolled shelter cloth begins sliding along the grass.

introduces.waiting_place: With the cloth safe, the keeper asks where visitors should wait while a whale is turning.

introduces.whale_choice: The smallest whale turns toward the island, then hesitates as the pair pulses again.

introduces.route_compare: The keeper lays your observations beside Olivia's shortcut drawing.

introduces.handoff_sky: A second kitsune keeper arrives from the shelter.

introduces.sky_record: Your party has done the work needed to make the approaches safe.

introduces.sky_repair: Olivia and the keepers have both named a consequence that could outlast your visit.

introduces.guide_limits: Your guide plants both front fins in the wet mud at the edge of the bank.

introduces.ground_test: Orin has a short measuring stick and a coil of plain cord beside his bag.

introduces.base_record: Before any silt is moved, Orin asks for a picture of the bank as you found it.

introduces.tools_bridge: A loose bundle of Orin's measuring cord rolls toward the pale crust.

introduces.silt_compare: Orin places a pinch of loose silt on a flat stone beside grit from the upper bank.

introduces.bank_work: A small run of loose silt slips from the work shelf.

introduces.arch_question: From the firm shelf you can see two possible places to inspect.

introduces.river_explain: The waterline and smooth river pebbles appear in your notes beside the dry channel.

introduces.share_record: Orin offers to carry a copy of the bridge drawing to other Riftseekers.

introduces.restore_bank: The inspection is finished, but loose silt and a viewing board must not become the next traveler's surprise.

introduces.guide_handover: Your guide asks you to explain the finished place from the mud-bank boundary, where future visitors will ask their questions.

introduces.valley_arrival: Pip Thistledown, a young manticore scout, follows the road north with your party.

introduces.look_again: Pip stops beside an old route marker, a dark stone with a fork-shaped chip.

introduces.worker_signal: The yeti worker raises a walking staff and points at the broad shelf beside them.

introduces.two_jobs: The worker introduces herself as one of the yetis who checks paths between the glacier reading rooms.

introduces.test_flow: The worker places three loose stones on a board to stand for the two banks and a central rock.

introduces.bundle_plan: The second worker arrives on the far path and stops beside the lantern.

introduces.anchor: A firm rock projects from the upper bank beside the worker.

introduces.signals: The far worker lifts the lantern to ask whether she should move.

introduces.tools_return: With the signals understood, the far worker ties the tool bundle to the end of the carrying line.

introduces.crossing_choice: The worker shows you two ways to reach the far path and the reading rooms beyond it.

introduces.river_turn: From the far path, the ridges look familiar but the stream points down the valley your earlier map left dry.

introduces.return_water: A narrow tongue of water begins creeping along the old bed behind you.

introduces.tell_together: The water now runs again along the older bed.

introduces.next_witness: The worker offers to take your account to an elder yeti at a nearby reading room.

introduces.last_check: Before leaving the crossing, the workers ask your party to test the upper warning as if you had just arrived.

introduces.valley_change: the river has returned to its older bed

introduces.room_arrival: An elder yeti welcomes your party at a room cut into the glacier.

introduces.quiet_rule: The elder sets a cup of warm tea on a flat stone and waits until every hero is inside the marked waiting space.

introduces.witness_first: The route worker gives the elder a drawing of the two valleys.

introduces.catalog_cards: Three small catalog cards rest beside the ice.

introduces.listening_floor: A faint low song travels through the floor from a hall elsewhere in the ice.

introduces.support_ice: The memory face remains part of the glacier.

introduces.first_memory: Within the pale ice, a small moving view becomes clear.

introduces.second_view: The elder leads you to a second marked viewpoint, still on the safe floor.

introduces.what_matches: The outside drawing and the memory account lie together on the elder's stone table.

introduces.catalog_test: A younger yeti keeper brings a fresh catalog slip and asks where the new account belongs.

introduces.sliding_tray: While the younger keeper puts the catalog slip away, a shallow tray begins sliding on a patch of meltwater beside the work table.

introduces.compare_accounts: The elder asks whether your party has another checked observation of a river where today's geography does not fit it.

introduces.claim_limit: Before the younger keeper copies the final sentence, the elder asks what it must not claim.

introduces.record_choice: The elder offers to keep a copy of your party's finished comparison beside the memory catalog.

introduces.teach_back: An arriving yeti visitor waits at the warm cup, just as your party did.

introduces.island_arrival: a folded landing board, signal cloths and a wooden box of song slips

introduces.island_song: The keeper opens the box of song slips.

introduces.island_sightings: A notch on the approaching island slides past a distant cloud break.

introduces.island_priority: A gust lifts the corner of the song box and sets it rattling.

introduces.island_letters: The messenger bag hangs against the inside of the low fence.

introduces.island_station: The song slips flutter inside their open box.

introduces.island_signals: The keeper lays a white cloth and a striped cloth on the grass.

introduces.island_window: The returning island clears the cloud with a flat shelf facing the lookout.

introduces.island_landing: The keeper lays the landing board across the close shelves.

introduces.island_stone: On the returning island, the standing stone has a round hole and a broad carved face.

introduces.island_copy: The shallow grooves are hard to separate from the grass shadows.

introduces.island_orientation: The keeper sets a present-day lookout sketch beside your copy.

introduces.island_comparison: Three raised marks appear on your copy beside the present lookout sketch.

introduces.island_limits: Pip looks from the stone to the lookout sketch.

introduces.island_permission: The keeper asks permission to keep a copy of your observations.

introduces.island_handoff: The returning island continues past the lookout instead of stopping.

introduces.island_recovery_kit: The keeper can lend a pocket brush and spare a sheet

introduces.skupper_guide: On the Saltrot mudflats, an opening in the air blinks away and comes back. Through it lies snow. A snowhorn goat stands belly-deep in mud beside it, chewing a reed with great disappointment. Your Skupper guide from the Saltrot bank waves her fins in greeting, then points to the rising tide. "Bring that goat home before the opening closes. I can find firm mud. I cannot make a goat like it."
introduces.blinking_gap: an opening in the air blinks

introduces.yard_guide: At the edge of the Bone Yard, your Skupper guide from the flats stops in a brackish pool. Beyond her, broken stone walls have appeared among enormous old bones. Small bone crawlers crowd the fresh shimmer around the walls. "Clear a safe way past those ruins," she says. "Take nothing. Here, anything taken comes back. I will watch from water that suits my fins." One crawler is trying to fit its whole body under a pebble.

introduces.nest_bench: using a bench as a pillow

introduces.temple_keeper: The island you helped welcome home is drifting toward a temple island through heavy rain. A different kitsune keeper from the one at the lookout rings a lookout bell; its rope wears a tiny raincoat. Beside the temple, a fresh opening spills bone crawlers onto the wet landing: little scuttling creatures with jointed legs and rattling backs. "Keep the temple safe as that island drifts toward us," the keeper calls. "We can push its approach clear, or shelter this landing and let it settle." She points to people still carrying cushions across the yard.

introduces.converge_travelers: At a sheltered glacier ledge, Orin waves you over to a map on an upturned sled. Olivia greets you and steadies one corner. Your Riftseeker friends have made room for your account. A bigfoot named Bram Lock keeps the path clear. "Help me keep everyone behind the line when an opening comes," he asks. Orin weights the map with his boot. "Compare your discoveries. Then help us steady any opening before people go near it." His boot is still on his foot.

introduces.final_companions: Orin Vale, the griffin scholar, and Seren Wisp, the kitsune teacher

introduces.final_brace: Seren shows how its pressure eases when the ridge is held still.
